section: The Yee grid and cell size
subgoals: Compute the shortest wavelength in the densest dielectric
Divide it by the required number of cells per wavelength

label: The Courant stability limit
subgoals: Identify the smallest cell and the fastest wave speed
Divide the cell size by c times the square root of the dimension
Use that bound as the largest stable time step

label: Time steps and run cost
subgoals: Divide the simulated duration by the time step
Round up to an integer number of steps
Scale the work by cells times steps when refining
